Our impact

Kids we have already taught.

About 5,000 children trained in Cameroon holiday programs. About 1,500 learning now. About 30 in the 2024 McKinney pilot.

Source: AfroBot records, November 2026. Glappy Foundation’s Cameroon record reports the children learning now.

Where this happened

Cameroon

Since November 2022, about 4 years. Holiday training and ongoing school groups.

McKinney, Texas

A 2024 pilot of about 30 students. Build Day is already on the events page.
